related.title: LoRA：低秩更新與可訓練參數
related.titleEn: LoRA: low-rank updates and trainable parameters
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視角配對矩陣、溫度曲線與增強審核。；兩損失正確，正例索引唯一，對角排除且增強保留教學目標。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver view-pair matrices,temperature curves and augmentation audits.; Losses match,positive indices are unique,self is excluded and augmentations preserve the teaching target.
related.difference: 標A的r×din、B的dout×r與α/r縮放；列凍結及可訓練參數群組。；8192及16384正確，凍結權重不更新，合併前後差小於教學1e−6。
related.differenceEn: Label A r×din,B dout×r and alpha/r scaling; list frozen and trainable groups.; Counts match,base weights remain frozen and merge differences stay below teaching1e−6.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化一正一負例損失L=ln(1+exp((s負−s正)/τ))；此為縮小候選集合示例。；教學s正.8,s負.2,τ.2；改τ.4。；L=ln(1+exp(−3))=.04858735；改τ.4得.20141328。
W為dout×din，ΔW=BA，rank r參數量r(din+dout)；基底權重仍需儲存。；教學din=dout=512,r8；改r16，不計偏置。；P=8×(512+512)=8192；r16時16384，完整W為262144。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A one-positive/one-negative example has L=ln(1+exp((sneg−spos)/tau)); this is a reduced candidate set.; Teaching positive similarity.8,negative.2,tau.2 then.4.; L=ln(1+exp(−3))=.04858735; tau.4 gives.20141328.

For W=dout×din and deltaW=BA,rank r uses r(din+dout) parameters; base weights still occupy storage.; Teaching din=dout512,r8 then16,excluding bias.; P=8×(512+512)=8192; r16 gives16384,versus262144 for full W.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AMD CDNA 晶粒：工作切分與慢端效應

related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視角配對矩陣、溫度曲線與增強審核。；兩損失正確，正例索引唯一，對角排除且增強保留教學目標。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver view-pair matrices,temperature curves and augmentation audits.; Losses match,positive indices are unique,self is excluded and augmentations preserve the teaching target.
related.difference: 區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化一正一負例損失L=ln(1+exp((s負−s正)/τ))；此為縮小候選集合示例。；教學s正.8,s負.2,τ.2；改τ.4。；L=ln(1+exp(−3))=.04858735；改τ.4得.20141328。
相同速率的平行分區在屏障前以最大工作量決定時間；負載效率=總工作/(分區數×最大工作)。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四個教學分區的工作為100、100、100、180單位；相同速率且忽略互連成本。 效率=480/(4×180)=66.6667%；重新平衡為四個120則理想效率100%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A one-positive/one-negative example has L=ln(1+exp((sneg−spos)/tau)); this is a reduced candidate set.; Teaching positive similarity.8,negative.2,tau.2 then.4.; L=ln(1+exp(−3))=.04858735; tau.4 gives.20141328.

Equal-rate partitions finish at the largest workload; load efficiency=total/(partition count×maximum). All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four teaching partitions carry100, 100, 100, 180 units at equal rates, initially ignoring interconnect cost. Efficiency=480/(4×180)=66.6667%; four balanced120-unit partitions reach ideal100%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
